# Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation

> The Gates Foundation funds innovation and forges global partnerships to save lives and reduce inequity in health, development, and education across Africa, Asia, and beyond.

The Gates Foundation is a philanthropic organization committed to global health, poverty reduction, and educational opportunity. The site features strategic reports, impact stories, and research highlighting work in vaccine innovation, maternal health, disease elimination, and economic empowerment across developing regions.

## Key Topics

- Global Health
- Vaccines & Immunization
- Child Mortality Prevention
- Maternal Health
- Disease Elimination
- Women Empowerment
- Economic Opportunity
- Africa
- Health Innovation
- Poverty Reduction
- Gender Equality
- Global Development
- Philanthropy
- GAVI
- PEPFAR

## Foundation Overview & Strategy

- [Our Work: How We Drive Global Impact at Gates Foundation](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/our-work): Overview of Gates Foundation's work across health, development, and education.
- [Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Origin Story & Key Milestones](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/about/our-story): Gates Foundation's founding story and key milestones from inception to present.
- [The Gates Foundation's Role in Global Progress](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/about/our-role): Gates Foundation's role in funding innovation and forging global partnerships.
- [The 2026 Gates Foundation Annual Letter: Reaching 2045](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/2026-gates-foundation-annual-letter): 2026 annual letter outlining Gates Foundation's strategic roadmap to 2045 goals.

## Global Health & Disease Prevention

- [2025 Goalkeepers Report | Ending Preventable Child Deaths](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/goalkeepers/report/2025-report): 2025 Goalkeepers Report on preventing child deaths through vaccines and primary healthcare.
- [Saving Lives and Expanding Opportunity for Children](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/core-mission-child-health-success): Gates Foundation's core mission on child health across Liberia, Kenya, and South Africa.
- [Cabo Verde Eliminated Malaria - What the World Can Learn](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/cabo-verde-malaria-eradication-lessons): Cabo Verde's malaria eradication model as blueprint for global health progress.
- [How One Health Worker Helped Liberia Stop a Polio Resurgence](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/polio-outbreak-vaccination-response): Health worker Evans Lablah's vaccination campaign stopping polio in Liberia.
- [The Global Fund Works: Fighting HIV, TB, and Malaria Together](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/global-fund-impact-stories): Global Fund's impact on HIV, TB, and malaria prevention and treatment.
- [How PEPFAR Changes Lives: Lessons from Kenya](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/pepfar-impact-on-hiv-aids): PEPFAR's life-saving impact on HIV/AIDS prevention in Kenya.

## Women's Health & Empowerment

- [Why investing in women is a must for achieving global success](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/investing-in-women-jackie-jones): Gates Foundation's case for investing in women's empowerment globally.
- [Experience the life of an OB-GYN with Dr. Hadizi Galadanci](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/obgyn-experience-photo-essay-dr-hadiza-galadanci): Photo essay on maternal health through OB-GYN Dr. Hadiza Galadanci's work.
- [Heritage Crops Help Nigerian Women Farmers Thrive](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/cowpea-variety-farmer): Nigerian farmer using climate-resilient cowpeas for agricultural leadership.

## Economic Opportunity & Development

- [How inclusive digital finance services are helping Nigerian market sellers](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/digital-finance-nigeria-market-sellers): Digital finance innovation empowering market vendors in Lagos, Nigeria.
- [Partners of Human Potential](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/partners-human-potential): Stories of Gates Foundation partners working on health, education, and development.

## Education & Language Preservation

- [Bilingual education model preserves Wolof and Senegal's future](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/senegal-bilingual-education-is-transforming-the-country): ARED bilingual education model in Senegal preserving Wolof language.
- [Video: Bilingual education in Senegal classrooms](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/video/bilingual-education): Video showcasing bilingual education program in Senegal teaching Wolof and French.

## News & Research Hub

- [Ideas - Global News and Research From the Gates Foundation](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas): Hub for Gates Foundation news, research, and trends in global development.

## Optional

- [Take the quiz to learn more about the future of global health](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/future-of-global-health-quiz): Interactive quiz on future global health innovations and vaccines.
- [Take The Vaccine Quiz](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/ideas/articles/gavi-vaccine-quiz): Interactive vaccine knowledge quiz testing understanding of immunization.
